queries_run: United Therapeutics distribution channel change 2026 specialty pharmacy Tyvaso

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：美國通路仍為 Accredo 與 CVS Specialty 兩家非獨家特殊藥局經銷商，Unituxin 由 Cencora 獨家；未見通路結構性轉變
findings.excerpt: We have entered into separate, non-exclusive distribution agreements with Accredo and CVS Specialty to distribute Tyvaso DPI, Nebulized Tyvaso, Remodulin, the Remunity and RemunityPRO Pumps, and Orenitram in the United States, and we have entered into an exclusive distribution agreement with Cencora Global Procurement Ltd. to distribute Unituxin in the United States.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋僅回 SEC 文件（含 2026 Q1、Q3 10-Q），搜尋摘要稱通路描述未變、未見新特殊藥局或轉換；Adcirca Lilly 授權 2026-12-31 到期（摘要轉述，未取得逐字原文）。

clues.claim: Q3 2026 10-Q：通路仍為 Accredo 與 CVS Specialty；Adcirca 授權 2026-12-31 到期不續
